channel.title: Jaeheung Lee | Manufacturing & Process Engineer
channel.description: Manufacturing and process-engineering portfolio covering battery production, semiconductor components, equipment FAT/SAT, quality improvement, and manufacturing DX

item.title: 2170 Assembly-Line Good-Yield Stabilization
item.description: Equipment-reported yield and full-inspection good yield did not agree, so true process defects and inspection misclassification had to be separated under one basis. I contributed to the team result of stabilizing monthly average good yield from about 40% to 98.7% and directly revised the MSA criteria, SOP, QCP, P-FMEA, and inspection standards.

item.title: 4695 Assembly Auto-Cycle Recovery and Limited-Production Transition
item.description: No equipment could run automatically from Start through completion and normal MES history was absent, so assembly production-start conditions had to be rechecked against an initial SAT baseline. Two 100-cell lots and a final 50-cell one-way run confirmed the limited-production start conditions, and I revised or created work standards, QCP, P-FMEA, checklists, and MES control items.

item.title: 25P LFP Power Cell Process Development and Trial-Production Validation
item.description: Electrolyte, clad tab, turn count, can height, and inspection conditions all changed from the existing 2170 cell, requiring new process conditions from impregnation through downstream assembly. A/B/C samples, about 20,000-cell trial production, customer qualification, and CCB P.O approval were completed; commercial production did not proceed because of pricing.

item.title: 2170 Tabless Structure A-Sample Manufacturability Validation
item.description: With no dedicated equipment or jigs, the existing 4695 line had to produce a tabless structure while internal laser entry, shorts, and assembly damage were checked. Failure modes were separated across about 100 exploratory builds, producing five functional samples and confirming A-sample structural build feasibility and functional direction.

item.title: NCM Prismatic Pilot-Line Acceptance and Initial Stabilization
item.description: Limited FAT samples and individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, repeatability, or readiness for actual production. The team observed an initial snapshot of about 95% over roughly five days and 1,000 cells, including cells meeting criteria after rework, and documented FAT/SAT, MSA, and operating standards. It is not FPY or long-term production yield.

item.title: Alternative Can Supplier Pilot Transition
item.description: The incumbent supplier could not cover the planned follow-on volume alone, so a new can supplier required manufacturing and quality validation. After 600 cells across three lots and an official UN38.3 pass, purchasing and subsequent pilot production moved to the alternative can after existing stock was consumed.

item.title: NCM Pre-Forming Process Validation
item.description: Manual shaping before pre-welding varied by operator and repeatedly created uncoated-edge damage and short-circuit risk. The condition was verified with about 400 samples, used in subsequent pilot production, and reflected in process/inspection standards, the P-FMEA, and production-equipment RFQ.

item.title: Transfer-Robot Overhaul Standard-System Development
item.description: At YMC's new-business start, the new model had no parts list, overhaul manuals, inspection manual, or precision-setting criteria. Initial YMC qualification and about five units of one model were followed by deeper repeat-overhaul, operator, parts, and field standards at Bontech.

item.title: High-Temperature Anodizing Development for Display Equipment Parts
item.description: A higher OLED process temperature exposed cracks and particles in a mixed-acid film for upper-electrode-type parts, while susceptor-type parts required a separate high-temperature qualification. The mixed-acid condition passed customer qualification and received about one year of additional follow-up; the oxalic-acid condition completed repeated 450℃ screening and customer vacuum-heat qualification before about one year of use.

item.title: Mixed-Acid Anodizing Bath Analysis and Replenishment Standardization
item.description: Legacy bath values appeared normal, but etch-rate, particle, and film-quality problems repeated after about three months. The project standardized the analysis SOP, log sheet, replenishment/replacement decision, and product-sample checks for the target baths and China site.

item.title: Technical Qualification of CVD and PECVD Components for a Global Display-Equipment Maker
item.description: Counterpart samples from the same bath and process still produced different Hi-Pot decisions when equipment, repeats, and test sequence differed. One audit finding was closed through aligned measurement conditions and retesting, followed by qualification notice and about one year of supply.

item.title: Diffuser Ultrasonic Stripping Scale-up Failure and Stop Gates
item.description: The initial chemical-plus-ultrasound trial reduced stripping time, but removing the chemical without fume exhaust increased work time, manual effort, and surface damage. Normal operation stopped because cavitation erosion, particles, and reuse failed; the case produced stop gates for future scale-up.

item.title: Cell S/N Production-History Trace Tool
item.description: Process-level MES data existed, but a cell's full history was not connected, so investigating ten customer-requested cells took about three days. A single search took 5–10 seconds and a ten-cell investigation about three minutes; the tool was used on site during my employment and handed over.

item.title: GIGA Press Digital Twin and Autonomous Factory PoC
item.description: Physical-equipment try-out requires repeated material and engineering effort, while inconsistent state meaning across PLC, equipment, and monitoring makes chronic loss difficult to trace. The ten-person team demonstrated Factory I/O, PLC/Ladder, SCADA/OPC UA, and web integration. DQN remained a model-selection and integration-design layer.

item.title: Automotive Factory Digital Twin DX Project
item.description: Existing robot programs and equipment state were isolated in pendant data and individual files, making PC review and Digital Twin integration difficult. The ten-person team demonstrated the flow from QR input to Robot C routing, and the later public code added JSON load/edit/save and a read-only Twin state path.

item.title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images
item.description: A model trained on public weld images lost substantial performance on practical specimens containing soot, spatter, reflections, and capture variation. Recall on captured specimens rose from 15.84% to 85.15%, a gain of 69.31 percentage points, and the team completed a ResNet+DeiT and FastAPI/PWA inspection demo.

item.title: HeungTology for Collecting and Searching Manufacturing Knowledge
item.description: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. Markdown source management, incremental synchronization, candidate retrieval, and reranking are implemented. Source-location display, authorization, and repeated retrieval evaluation can extend it into an operating manufacturing-knowledge tool.

item.title: Checking Evidence and Approval Before AI Takes Action
item.description: An AI reading material and proposing work does not grant execution authority or prove safe completion. The current result defines evidence, work scope, human approval, stop, and result-verification order. Restricted execution, an authorization UI, and external state checks can extend it into an execution-oriented agent.

item.title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates
item.description: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.

item.title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions
item.description: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.

item.title: Deep Learning Model Study Log
item.description: Running example code is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained again. The current result is a checklist for data, configuration, and evaluation in manufacturing AI experiments. It can be extended into reproducible experiment cases by connecting notebooks, data sources, settings, and results.
